description: Work with existing footnotes and endnotes: convert footnotes to endnotes or back (Type > Convert Footnote and Endnote), turn footnotes into ordinary text, delete notes, or go to a note's reference or text (Go to Footnote Reference / Go to Endnote Reference). Note ids come from get_long_document_info.

action.description: What to do. Conversions move each note's plain text (local formatting is not kept) and keep its reference position

ids.description: Note ids; for conversions and delete, absent means every note in scope

kind.description: Which notes delete, show_reference and show_text act on

storyId.description: Limit to the notes of one story

name: manage_footnotes
title: Manage Footnotes
